CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and presented as coordinate set and a separate origin/status field is present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification lines name contents (colour) bound to coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content coordinate listings, attributing presentation/status information to contents.

O.rationale: Contents are presented as explicit coordinate sets (organized representation) for identified referents.
